description:

💻 Microsoft 365 | Azure | Automatisierung | Digitalisierung
 Du möchtest nicht nur IT-Systeme verwalten, sondern aktiv mitgestalten, wie moderne Technologien, Automatisierungen und digitale Prozesse in einem Unternehmen eingesetzt werden?
 Dann könnte diese Position genau das Richtige für dich sein.

title: Senior Account Manager (Digital Marketing)
description:
Solvi Digital is a B2B digital marketing agency built for the industrial world, manufacturers, distributors, engineers, construction, renewables, logistics and the trades. We help traditional businesses modernise how they win work and how they show up online, across paid media, SEO, cold outreach, websites, email and social.
 We're looking for a Senior Account Manager to own a portfolio of client accounts end to end. This isn't a pure coordination role. We need someone hands-on and switched on, who can sit in front of a client, present strategy, answer the technical questions and know what good actually looks like, without leaning on someone else to tell them.
 This is a fully remote role. You'll need a full UK driving licence, as occasionally (roughly once a quarter) you may visit a client for a shoot day.
 Tasks
 What you'll do
 Own a portfolio of industrial B2B client accounts, acting as their main point of contact and trusted advisor
 Run client meetings independently, present strategy, handle questions and manage expectations without senior support
 Set the direction across paid media, SEO, cold outreach, websites and social, and steer the specialists who deliver it
 Know your numbers, read campaign performance, spot when something isn't working and know why, and steer it back on track
 Build lead-generation strategy end to end, from the offer and audience through to the funnel and follow-up
 Spot upsell and cross-sell opportunities and have those conversations naturally
 Keep clients for the long term by delivering real results and being genuinely on top of their account
 Requirements
 What we're looking for
 This role covers a lot of ground, so we need real breadth and genuine hands-on experience, not just familiarity:
 5+ years in marketing, with 3+ years agency-side managing multiple client accounts at once
 Ideally some in-house marketing experience earlier in your career, so you understand delivery from both sides

description:

 ​​​​ PartSpace ist ein wachstumsstarkes, innovatives Tech-Unternehmen mit einer klaren Mission: Mit Künstlicher Intelligenz und echten Engineering-Daten definiert PartSpace den technischen Einkauf der Zukunft neu. Unsere cloudbasierte Plattform macht die Beschaffung von Bauteilen in der Industrie intelligenter - und agiert dabei wie ein Ingenieur.

 Bei uns bekommst du nicht nur Gestaltungsfreiraum und Mitspracherecht - du wirst Teil eines ambitionierten Teams, das täglich mit Leidenschaft daran arbeitet, unsere KI-Plattform weiterzuentwickeln und die industrielle Beschaffung nachhaltig zu verändern - und das ist unser Anspruch. Um unser Wachstum weiter voranzutreiben, suchen wir Dich als Senior Backend Entwickler (m/w/d) im Manufacturing-Bereich am Standort Deggendorf oder München.
 Lust, mit uns die Industrie effizienter zu machen? Dann freuen wir uns, dich kennenzulernen!

title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer, Search & Recommendations
description:
Teamwork makes the stream work.

 

Roku is changing how the world watches TV

Roku is the #1 TV streaming platform in the U.S., Canada, and Mexico, and we've set our sights on powering every television in the world. Roku pioneered streaming to the TV. Our mission is to be the TV streaming platform that connects the entire TV ecosystem. We connect consumers to the content they love, enable content publishers to build and monetize large audiences, and provide advertisers unique capabilities to engage consumers.

From your first day at Roku, you'll make a valuable - and valued - contribution. We're a fast-growing public company where no one is a bystander. We offer you the opportunity to delight millions of TV streamers around the world while gaining meaningful experience across a variety of disciplines.

 

What does the team work on?

Roku is the No. 1 TV streaming platform in the U.S., Canada, and Mexico with 70+ million active accounts. Roku pioneered streaming to the TV and continues to innovate and lead the industry. The depth of query, content, and user understanding using ML is key to user happiness on the search and discovery journey, and this team owns the models that power it across the Roku platform.

What is the role?

The depth of query, content and user understanding using ML is key to user happiness in their search journey. Solving this customer problem is why we’re actively looking for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer, Search & Recommendations to drive further innovation in search and discovery.
